flatHead.answer: OCCLUDED AT EVERY RANK AND EVERY RADIUS. 0.33 < 1/haloFar = 0.333333 is pure constant arithmetic — it needs no radius, no mark and no measurement.

strongerThanTheSeatRing.note: the seat's opaque FILL alone reaches r, and the flat head's outer radius at the worst rank is 0.33 * haloFar = 0.99 r < 1, so the ring is not even required
strongerThanTheSeatRing.caveat: the seat RING carries the body's own dash pattern (LINE_DASH dotted/open/broken), so through a dash gap the guaranteed occluder is the fill alone and the margin is this sub-pixel figure, not the ring's 1.68 px. The CONCLUSION is unaffected; the MARGIN is.

flatHead.consequence: the flat head is never sampled, so the observable ramp is strictly decreasing and strict-versus-non-increasing is not a difference.

andTheOtherWayToo.claimWas: the tail cannot read strictly decreasing, by pigeonhole on 11 byte levels over 11.76 px
andTheOtherWayToo.whyItFails: 11 was one channel's levels; luminance sums three channels whose code crossings do not coincide
andTheOtherWayToo.note: so there is ONE reason the flat head is never sampled, not two: the truncation. The all-channel quantum that made the count look small is also the wrong quantum for a cyan glow — one BLUE code is 2.7834e-05, 13.85x finer.
